Hi Marissa / Alex,

Looping you in — FinLytics (cc’d: Emily) is evaluating inference for document ingestion and downstream extraction. We did an initial discovery and they’re interested in seeing Redwood’s hosted flow and Dedicated options for predictable throughput.

Emily — FinLytics is an analytics platform focused on financial reporting for SMBs; they were referred to us by TechSys for a demo and quick pricing orientation. Would you be able to introduce a few stakeholders and share preferred times for a 30–45 minute demo next week?

I attached a short overview from FinLytics for context.

Hi Brian — thanks for the intro, and hi Emily, great to meet you.

We’d love to run a short product demo tailored to ingestion and cost/latency considerations. A couple quick Qs to tailor the session:
- Primary goals for the demo (POC, procurement, technical evaluation)?
- Attendees/roles you expect (CTO, engineering, product)?
- Any platform constraints (cloud, data residency, on-prem)?

I have these slots available next week (PT):
• Tue 9/14 10:00–10:45 PT
• Wed 9/15 11:00–11:45 PT
• Thu 9/16 08:30–09:15 PT

If those don’t work, happy to coordinate — and if you prefer, I can hand off scheduling to our AE to set the final time.

Our preferred time is Mon 9/13 10:00 AM ET (that would be 07:00 PT) — we can do 30 minutes to start. If that slot is tight, later on Mon or Tue morning ET also works.
